run.question:
Alertmanager alert PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus since 2026-11-17T05:55:35Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert is real in the sense that the rule is loaded into this Prometheus, but the evidence shows the notification path has nothing to connect to: no Alertmanager workload, Service, Endpoints or pod exists anywhere in the cluster. The Prometheus rule file defines PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers as max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1 for 10m, and complete cluster-wide enumerations (66 pods, 52 Services, 36 Deployments, 6 StatefulSets, 5 Endpoints in namespace prometheus) contain no Alertmanager object at all, so Prometheus can only discover zero Alertmanagers. Prometheus itself is running and ready (StatefulSet 1/1, pod ready with 0 restarts, Service endpoint 100.96.5.74:9090 matching the alert instance) and all nodes are Ready, so this is not a Prometheus-down or node problem. What cannot be verified from the available sources is the Prometheus object's actual spec.alerting (it is rendered into a Secret that cannot be read) and whether an Alertmanager custom resource exists but was never reconciled; therefore no single object can be named as the origin of the missing Alertmanager, and the root cause is left null with hypotheses recorded.

claims.text: The Prometheus rule file mounted into Prometheus (ConfigMap prometheus/prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0) defines alert PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers with expr max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1, for: 10m and label severity: warning, so the alert can only fire while that series exists and reports fewer than 1 discovered Alertmanager.

The complete cluster-wide pod list returned at 2026-11-17T06:45:15Z (66 pods, returned_count 66 of 66, truncated false) contains no Alertmanager pod; the only pods in namespace prometheus are prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator-57d68989cc-hkbnh, prometheus-kube-state-metrics-7c5fb9d798-tqssx, prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 and five prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter pods.

The complete cluster-wide Service list (52 services) contains no Alertmanager Service: neither a chart-style prometheus-kube-prometheus-alertmanager Service nor the operator-created alertmanager-operated Service exists; the Services in namespace prometheus are prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator, prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus, prometheus-kube-state-metrics, prometheus-operated (headless, selector app.kubernetes.io/name=prometheus) and prometheus-prometheus-node-exporter.

The complete cluster-wide StatefulSet list (6 StatefulSets) contains no Alertmanager StatefulSet; the only StatefulSet in namespace prometheus is prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus (1 replica, created 2026-11-16T06:41:35Z).
The complete cluster-wide Deployment list (36 deployments) contains no alertmanager Deployment.

The Endpoints objects in namespace prometheus (5) cover only operator (100.96.4.60:10250), prometheus (100.96.5.74:9090/8080), kube-state-metrics, prometheus-operated (100.96.5.74:9090) and node-exporter; there are no Alertmanager endpoints, while the prometheus Service endpoint 100.96.5.74:9090 is exactly the instance address in the alert.

Prometheus StatefulSet prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus is 1/1 ready with currentRevision equal to updateRevision (prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-677d847d59), i.e. no pending rollout, and its pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 is Running and ready on node i-0bc0544469bfef13a with 0 restarts of the prometheus and config-reloader containers; the pod's status.startTime is 2026-11-17T05:55:03Z.
All 5 nodes report Ready=True with MemoryPressure, DiskPressure and PIDPressure False, including i-0bc0544469bfef13a on which the Prometheus pod runs.

The alertmanagers.monitoring.coreos.com CRD is installed (group monitoring.coreos.com, kind Alertmanager, served version v1) and ClusterRole prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator grants verbs ["*"] on alertmanagers, alertmanagers/finalizers, alertmanagers/status and alertmanagerconfigs, so the operator is authorized to manage Alertmanager resources; the operator pod prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator-57d68989cc-hkbnh is Running and ready with 0 restarts.

Across the 56 ConfigMaps read cluster-wide, the only object whose data mentions 'alertmanager' is prometheus/prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-rulefiles-0, in its alert rule files (prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-general.rules-f1a18520-... and prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-ac4fa589-...); no ConfigMap carries an Alertmanager endpoint or service configuration.

The events retained for this window (source range 2026-11-17T06:02:55Z to 06:35:41Z, 26 kind/namespace/reason groups) contain no event whose involvedObject is in namespace prometheus and no Alertmanager-related event; the groups are ScalingReplicaSet, Job/PVC/PV/Pod/ReplicaSet/StatefulSet activities in data-recorders and otel-demo.

Prometheus itself is not down or unready and its scrape target is present: the StatefulSet reports 1/1 ready with no pending revision, pod prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0 is Running/ready with 0 container restarts, and Service/Endpoints for prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus expose 100.96.5.74:9090, the same instance the alert names; the failure is confined to the Alertmanager connection path, not to Prometheus serving or being scheduled.

Most likely explanation for the firing alert: Prometheus has zero Alertmanager targets to discover because no Alertmanager workload exists anywhere in this cluster - no Alertmanager StatefulSet, Deployment, Pod, Service or Endpoints object was returned - so prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered stays below 1 and the rule (which can only fire while that series exists) fires. The causal link from 'no Alertmanager object' to '0 discovered' is inferred from the rule expression plus the object enumerations, not read from Prometheus's own metric.

Alternative explanation that remains open: the Prometheus object's generated alerting configuration still lists an Alertmanager address (typically a prometheus-kube-prometheus-alertmanager Service on port 9093 in namespace prometheus), and Alertmanager service discovery resolves it to nothing because that Service/Endpoints object does not exist. The Prometheus config is rendered into a Secret that cannot be read, so which address is configured could not be verified.

Alternative explanation that remains open: the kube-prometheus-stack release in namespace prometheus was installed without the Alertmanager component (alertmanager disabled / the Alertmanager custom resource never created), while the chart's alerting rules were installed - which would leave Prometheus permanently with zero alertmanagers and this warning permanently firing. Supporting circumstance: none of the Alertmanager objects that come with that component (Service, StatefulSet, Endpoints) exist, and the alertmanager CRD and operator RBAC for alertmanagers are present, so the missing piece is the component, not the capability.

Rejected: 'an Alertmanager exists but is unhealthy/failing, e.g. all replicas down'. There is no Alertmanager pod, StatefulSet, Deployment, Service or Endpoints object in the cluster at all, so there is no deployed-but-broken Alertmanager to which this alert could be attributed.

Rejected: 'a node or scheduling problem removed the Alertmanager'. All 5 nodes are Ready with no memory, disk or PID pressure, and there is no pending, failed or evicted Alertmanager pod in the cluster-wide pod list.

Read the alerting section of the Prometheus object prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus in namespace prometheus (and the generated config Secret it references) and confirm which Alertmanager address/name it expects, then check whether an Alertmanager custom resource exists in namespace prometheus; this is the information the current tooling could not read.

If alert delivery from this Prometheus is intended, deploy/restore the Alertmanager component in namespace prometheus (Alertmanager resource plus its Service and StatefulSet, normally the kube-prometheus-stack Alertmanager with the operator-created alertmanager-operated Service) so that Prometheus discovers at least one Alertmanager; otherwise, remove or disable the PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers rule so a permanently empty alerting configuration does not keep producing this warning.

Read the prometheus container logs and the prometheus-operator logs for Alertmanager discovery/reconcile errors (for example errors resolving alertmanager addresses or a reconcile failure for a missing Alertmanager resource) and query Prometheus directly at prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus.prometheus:9090 for /api/v1/status/config and prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered; neither was reachable through the available tools in this Run.

gaps: Prometheus's generated configuration (including its alerting/Alertmanager section) is stored in a Secret mounted into the pod; secrets cannot be read, so whether spec.alerting lists an Alertmanager and which address it lists could not be verified.

Prometheus's own alerting metrics are not in the queryable Prometheus target: get_metric_names for {__name__=~"prometheus_notifications.*|alertmanager_.*|prometheus_config_.*"} returned nothing, the target's job label values are only kube-state-metrics, kubelet and otel-collector, and direct queries for kube_* series returned nothing, so the value of prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered could not be read directly.

Application and operator logs were not retrievable: fetch_pod_logs returned zero lines (0 bytes read) for all containers of prometheus-prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus-0, for prometheus-kube-prometheus-operator-57d68989cc-hkbnh and for prometheus-alert-recorder-0, so Alertmanager DNS/connection errors and operator reconcile errors could not be inspected.

The Alertmanager custom resource (monitoring.coreos.com/v1) cannot be read with the available Kubernetes tool kinds; whether an Alertmanager object exists in namespace prometheus but was never reconciled, versus never having been created, remains unknown - only the downstream StatefulSet/Service/Pod absence is observable.

Queries for objects whose names match 'alertmanager' returned no rows for ServiceAccounts, RoleBindings, Roles (namespace prometheus) and PodDisruptionBudgets; those views have status no_data and therefore only show that those queries matched nothing, not a proven absence.
Events are retained only from 2026-11-17T06:02:55Z (source range 06:02:55Z-06:35:41Z), so the reason the Prometheus pod was (re)created at 2026-11-17T05:55:03Z is not covered by any event.

The alert's firing time (2026-11-17T05:55:35Z) is only 32 seconds after the Prometheus pod's status.startTime (2026-11-17T05:55:03Z) while the rule requires the condition for 10m; the provenance of the alert start time could not be reconciled with the pod age from the available evidence.
The NetworkPolicy query for namespace prometheus returned no objects (no_data), so network-policy interference with Prometheus-to-Alertmanager traffic could not be assessed or ruled out.
Kubernetes objects reflect state at query time (06:45-06:48Z), not during the whole incident window, so whether an Alertmanager existed earlier in the window is unknown.
The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so who or what removed or never deployed the Alertmanager component cannot be determined.
No error or latency signals from the otel-demo application services were evaluated (they are outside the alert's scope); no otel-demo workload is implicated by any evidence gathered.
next_steps: Inspect the Prometheus object prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus (namespace prometheus) and its generated config Secret to read the alerting/alertmanager section.
List monitoring.coreos.com/v1 Alertmanager resources in namespace prometheus to confirm whether the Alertmanager custom resource exists and what its replica/endpoint state is.
Check prometheus-operator logs for alertmanager-related reconcile errors and the prometheus container logs for Alertmanager address-resolution errors.
Review Helm release history for the prometheus stack in namespace prometheus (alertmanager.enabled value and any recent change) via a change-history source, which is not integrated here.

PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers
    annotations:
      description: Prometheus {{$labels.namespace}}/{{$labels.pod}} is not connected
        to any Alertmanagers.
      runbook_url: https://runbooks.prometheus-operator.dev/runbooks/prometheus/prometheusnotconnectedtoalertmanagers
      summary: Prometheus is not connected to any Alertmanagers.
    expr: |-
      # Without max_over_time, failed scrapes could create false negatives, see
      # https://www.robustperception.io/alerting-on-gauges-in-prometheus-2-0 for details.
      max_over_time(prometheus_notifications_alertmanagers_discovered{job="prometheus-kube-prometheus-prometheus",namespace="prometheus"}[5m]) < 1
    for: 10m
    labels:
      severity: warning
